title: Scotty's Surf Co. Kauai
specs: Paddle 2.3 miles upriver to Secret Falls with a 1.2 mile hike
South Fork includes Fern Grotto, Jungle Cruise, and rock jump swimming hole
Water shoes or slippers with back strap recommended for hiking; hiking boots if knee, hip, or ankle instability
No kayak rentals on Saturday or Sunday per State of Hawaii
Single, tandem, and 2 adults + 1 child triple kayaks available
Smaller cars can carry up to 2 kayaks; larger vehicles up to 5 kayaks depending on size and weight
blurb: Guests rent single, double, or triple kayaks for self-guided tours on the Wailua River. Rentals include gear such as life jackets, dry bags, coolers with ice packs, walking sticks, and a map, plus a detailed in-person briefing. Trips can include paddling to Secret Falls with a hike or exploring the South Fork with Fern Grotto and a swimming hole.
extraNote: 24 hour full refund · No late fees or scheduled pickup times for standard rental · Cancellation only for extremely heavy rain and unsafe river crossing · Kinipopo Shopping Village next to Passion Bakery, 0.4 miles from the Wailua River boat ramp
